notes.title: Orc Massage DevLog #8
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to the first devlog in 2024.
Since February is the Lunar New Year and this is the Year of the Dragon.
Right, our character, Nefarlia, is a dragon.
So here is a special illustration from artist also the designer of dragongirl- カラスちゃん (@Karasu_Chan1204) , wishing you all a happy year of the Dragon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c0278a2f1129bd064cd45d57f97ee99a2b58e4a9.png[/img]

Furniture Custom System

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/1f03d175efc42f366704024295edbc556e697bed.gif[/img]

We have shown many types of furniture that have buff effects for both VIPs and regular customers. 
If your choices match the customer's preferences, you can increase your massage efficiency significantly.



Sex Scene Manual Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/f1d859c0e0b008ca21f076ec2f56082f8c056b47.gif[/img]
All existing poses now include idle animations, and a single left-click will trigger a single insertion. 
A series of quick clicks will enter the accelerated pumping mode, increasing the player's interactive experience.
	
Orc's Laptop Added Desktop System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/accb62d265210c170a459242244ac8670ea95646.png[/img]
Orc's laptop used to have a purchasing system, and now it includes a desktop system.
Besides the existing store app, a new community app has been added that allows you to view the current character status.



This is the progress of the development in January and February, thank you for your continuous attention to the Orc Massage!

notes.title: Orc Massage DevLog #7
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are very sorry to say that we are unable to release the content that we expected to update for this winter. We originally planned to release new gameplay features such as Essential Oils, Furniture, VIP community, etc., there're also new VIP animations.

This update has taken longer than we expected. We will announce the update schedule when we have a clear understanding of when it can be completed. We apologize for this delay.


Below is the devlog of this month.

1. New VIP Animation
Our dev team continues to work on new animations for Harpy, Tigirl and Mermaid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/a80823b36d0128eece10590501e500e98e808773.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/85b13ab2df6a81112f91066132da372e45a4ca03.png[/img]

For main building, we’re working on adding relative details to match the style of the character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/acfcf06c039c46ccb006c2a9a38a95819e760428.png[/img]

3.Elf Enhancement
As the first VIP, Elf is now undergoing character enhancements, especially for her feet. After all, Elf is the only VIP with human type feet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/13d26e0302827fde8ddc3e5eb9d0599baea2e631.png[/img]

4. Massage System Adjustment
Expected to add: The masseurs will need to be more considerate of the health of the individual parts of the VIPs, and will need to utilize the mystery reel and oils to help the VIP.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/37c24be377b7378429544966e9f8fcac5730ec75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c8b1e8e4d4a72cfaab9d027b90fcc70b988c398a.png[/img]




That's all devlog for now, and we apologize again for the delay in this update.

Happy Holidays!
Torch Studio

notes.title: New Update - New VIP Customers [Emma]
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdXl3aDU4N3FjZXc1M2k2OG56cWNqZ2VrZDZjdDFoYjRtYTY0cndmaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/1zX3Dgq00mXPdTKSUF/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone, Orc Massage has finally finally released the mermaid update. Thank you for your patience![/h1]

[h2]The main updates include the following:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thalia introduced Emma to the store, remember to buy a water pipe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/ea25518b1ff1ff422e5d58e420c99d1d4fee842f.png[/img]
[*] The time is running out, featuring day-night cycles time system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/1af429e70fdd29f6b1729ec6be218a413fd22c34.png[/img]
[/list]

Korean, Russian, and some translations are still being processed, so we are using 
machine translation to assist. We will update the translation as soon as it is officially completed.

[h2]Developer's Message[/h2]
Thank you very much for your support. This update has indeed taken a very long time. During this period, we have made significant adjustments to the game.


We hope that Orc Massage can have a relevant impact on the daily lives of VIPs after their massages. That's why we have added the VIP massage course and designed the comfort level for different body parts of VIPs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/4bc6a68d6993ef1e3a9fa594c638ca6b5fb51e49.png[/img]
We are also planning to develop “community” feature in the future. This will allow players to see small events related to the comfort or discomfort of VIPs in their daily lives.


By dividing the comfort levels of different body parts and adding a visualized “stress”  for characters. It is expected that the upcoming system will give players more options to assist the VIP massage.


About the next character【Dragon Girl】,we are continuously working on her design and development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/60ceb25fc3237e264dd58acdcb35a323f2eef3f0.png[/img]

[h2]About the devlog/devtalk[/h2]
The devtalk is a monthly message after the game released on steam to provide updates every month to keep everyone informed of the development progress.However, after discussions, we have decided to change it to every two months so that the content will be more rich when we make updates.

[h1]Once again, we sincerely thank you for supporting Orc Massage.[/h1]

notes.title: April DevLog
notes.content:
Hello to all Orc Massage players, this is the April devlog. In April and May, we are still fine-tuning the previous parts of the work. In the meantime, we are also continuing to plan for future updates of Mermaid.


[h2]March 2019[/h2]

This is the first post of Orc Massage. The original concept is only the entire Orc's massage store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/38bbf1ed4b38862337173e53a7a2ac1efcd83827.png[/img]
At that time, the entire game worldview and structure were originally built purely on the story of Orc and Elf in a small room.


[b][h3]But it's EXPANDING[/h3][/b]

Now there are at least six characters and a number of outdoor scenes. 
We decided to make it more abundant. Now we are changing the perspective of the game from a room to a town.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/cb06b94d0bf1fab91bdbc30c09bdd01e58a0910d.gif[/img]
(3D street arrangement)


Also working on the design of the important buildings (where the girls are located).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/8fa5cd3d7715156d779eb9c9eb972da2a60e27a6.png[/img]
(The Elf family's commercial building is under development)

notes.title: March DevLog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c7a9ebb4837c3d4a54f2c0f0871752ffb8d42507.png[/img]
[h1]A Message From The Developers[/h1]

We're excited to announce important news, Orc Massage is expected to be updated with new content during the[b] summer sale[/b]!

During the year-long journey we received a lot of feedback and comments, which drove us to continuously adjust and restructure our game.

The improvement of the program is especially focused on the trade-off between memory usage and reading speed. This is good for Mermaid because she will occupy more memory.

We have also created more details, hoping to make this world more lively.

Because the mermaid has two modes of human and fish, technically equal to two characters, there is also a lot of art content to be made.

Now we expect to release the above updates in the summer sale, thank you for your patience!

[h1]DragonGirl's Story[/h1]
The scriptwriting team are re-discussing the content of the DragonGirl's scripts, hoping to bring players a different experience from the previous characters

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/50b8945763fd3b45b9ab27a34a81f4f27d916ce0.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]November Devlog [/h1]

[h2]New Dub[/h2]

This month we finally decided on the right voices for the the Orc and the goblin Mr. Gobson. We think having a few grunts a noises coming out of the orc will help bring his character out just a tad bit.

[h2]Making Characters Theme Music[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/016e3639823c247557eb3727fea6067387a7573f.png[/img]

We are starting to double down a bit on creating the theme music for every character in the game including a main theme. While what we had in the game so far aren't placeholders or royalty free music, we understand the importance of sound design to help build a unique experience for Orc Massage. We will be working with multiple musical teams to deliver a rich OST.

Its also very important that the theme music is a good indication of the personality each girl has so we will be making sure to spend a good amount of time perfecting each tune. 

Also expect a radio system as well in the future so everyone can customize their turns when they are doing their thing to the girls.

notes.content:
Coming to the dev talk of October. 

It has been few months since we started making Mermaid.

Animations, models and other contents have already taken shape. The part that is currently being worked on is cutscenes.  We are currently putting in a lot of effort of the environment to give enrich the experience. 

[h2][b]Time System[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/3ec2f1de0f2dedb596d73e84391e9519d4367560.png[/img]

At the beginning we were only have daylight outside, but that not really representative on how hard working our big guy is! This works his ass off from day to night!  We are aiming to put in certain scenes  only available to certain times of the day! This will allow us to be more flexible with our story telling so look forward to that in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c1d8782911efc3e44f6cfb509e3ae3bbcea837db.png[/img]


[h2][b]We can do it[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/cbc64838925c1e39ffb2ff7c8e89080ac212825e.png[/img]

We received many people on Twitter asking questions about this poster and asking for a large resolution image.

The “We can do it” poster on the wall of the massage parlor seems to be just an ordinary decoration, but it does have a degree of significance to it. It represents a time when certain kinds of monsters were looked down upon. Orcs and other perceived savage monster races made an effort to fit in to society and this poster represents that time for change.

The boss Goblin put it in massage store as decoration and as little motivator for the Orc to remain diligent as his job!

This is the end of the October dev talk, thank you for your attention!

notes.title: Orc Massage has been region locked in Korea...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/5b254e47e25a288082426da63bf35396685139be.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We have sad news today in regards to Korean players and future Korean buyers that were looking into purchasing Orc Massage...

Orc Massage has managed to catch the attention of [i][b]the South Korean government [/b][/i]and has requested  Steam to ban Orc Massage in the country.  The game is now [b]region locked and will no longer be a game that Korean’s will be able to easily acquire on Steam[/b].

Sadly this is something we aren’t capable of doing anything about. 

But what we can do is continue to support [i][b]Koreans that have already purchased the game![/b][/i] Despite this set back we will continue to support Korean as a language. We also plan on putting Orc Massage on other stores that support adult games that will allow people to also play the title despite regional issues. 

We are very sorry about this situation. We highly value our players from any country and find this very unfortunate. Adult material still has many hurdles to deal with when it comes to social stigma, but that won't stop us from creation and delivering good experiences!

notes.title: Orc Massage exceeds 100,000 sales in one month!
notes.content:
Critical Bliss here!

Yup! You heard that right everyone. In just one month weeks Orc Massage has achieved over 100K sales! What an amazing turn out this was!

Thank you everyone for your understanding and support. This has changed the lives monumentally for Torch Studios and it adds another notch to our belt of successes on the Steam platform.

However as successful as this release was we understand fully that we are in the good graces of many people that see the potential in what Orc Massage can be in the future. We thank you fans new and old for your understanding and still giving us support. We are well aware of the current climate of games wanting solid experiences from the get go and it's simply a strong reminder to make sure we provide that!

We are most definitely paying attention to all feedback being given and we at Critical Bliss are working with Torch in order to ensure that we create the best horny massage game sim we possibly can.

[h2]Also big thanks to the community for being supportive and patient. See you guys at 150K!

notes.title: Orc Massage Early Access is Released!
notes.content:
Sorry for the slight delay (again...) but ORC MASSAGE IS OUT!

Thank you very much everyone for being patient with us. It's been a tough road for this game and torch studios, but we finally have it in a state where we can show what we've got to all of you!

Of course this is[i][b] an Early Access release so expect to see some "jank"[/b][/i]. However, the charming elements and the basic gameplay loop is here for all of you to enjoy.  

[h2]Here's our basic roadmap![/h2]

We will be going into more detail on what these each of these things mean later, but for now we will be primarily focused on optimizing before moving forward with more content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c3171c4ee45545da0de56a64888338b5f0c3e7c7.png[/img]

We will actively work on fixing any bugs that you guys report and this game will be a constant flux of updates.

you can post the stuff you find in this thread! 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1129540/discussions/0/3186862752320466283/

Big thanks to all of you for assisting us in this Early Access process in order to get this game to be the best that it can be.  Please report what you guys find so we can get it addressed ASAP!

notes.title: Orc Massage Early Access Release On February 8th!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! Critical Bliss here![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/b01dca882a1ef3f176de0eacd7e0f908c8de8869.gif[/img]

We are finally ready to unveil Orc Massage in EA status! We will official be launching the game in its EA form on the February 8th! 

Around this time we should have everything we need to roll things out. As we stated before in the previous update, our main focus is polishing the stuff we have now and making sure translations for the text we have are done in the languages we are launching with. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/4c809210f13543acd9058847f7ab60ed52b3542a.gif[/img]

The early  build will features 3 characters on launch that you'll be rubbing down while introducing our basic functions that we are starting with. We plan on further refining and expanding our massage system into something more detailed and intimate over the next few months. So stay tuned!

[h2]Regular Client Mini Game[/h2]

The Orc has to also take care of "General Customers" that come into the massage parlor. We will be expanding even more on regular clients in our game, but for right now they are regulated to a simple rhythm game for the Orc to grind on. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/48ac2f99393d91559047e49194f0de4c8f805070.gif[/img]


While we are pretty content with these mechanics at base, we plan on adding more skills, abilities, interesting situations, and modify to massage system to allow for more complexity in order to enhance the experience. We will be sharing our road map very soon that will give you guys a good look at all the things planned to come.

And of course its not a Critical Bliss game without a amazing soundtrack! The CB sound team will be in charge of that with this title and plan on working with many different composers to make a varied OST for the Massage Radio. We even plan on implementing the music mechanically into the game so you can look forward to that in the future. 

We thank all of you greatly for the support. [b]At this point for this game to realize it true potential it will require you guys![/b] Let's turn this into a solid success story like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/823910]Last Evil![/url]

notes.title: Orc Massage is coming!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Critical Bliss here!

After a rocky year of the development, Torch Studios is now ready to unveil what they have been working on for quite sometime. We are prepared now to release this game as early access! 

Sure while the game is an EA game we want to make sure this title is enjoyable from he start and is something that all of you would want to support in making this game into a great experience for everyone. 

Steam as well still needs to do more checks to make sure this game is meets the degree of standard for release as well. 

The main reason for this is that we have overlooked some things when we sent the executive files for review. As a result, at this stage the review of the orc massage parlor has not yet been approved.

As for the release date, we will tentatively set it for the end of January 2022, but if the review is approved in the meantime, we will try our best to move up the release date and will announce it to you.

In the mean time we will be giving you guys some updates in regards to what you can experience in the game on release!

See you guys really soon! Great things are to come!

notes.title: Steam Dev Log: Welcome to Orc Massage!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/6949790ac069b1f4e3e0c88167f315a499c4dcda.jpg[/img]

[h1]A massage from the publisher![/h1]

TorchEntertainment is getting Orc Massage nice and ready for an Early Access release coming in Q3 or sooner this year. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/823910/Last_Evil/]Similar to Last Evil[/url] these devs are going to need a bit of help to get to the end of their roadmap. From what we've seen behind closed doors though, we are sure a lot of you are going to have a good time with this little gem. 

The developers are a very inspired and motivated team from Taiwan and they have been working tirelessly in order to meet their own goals while taking feedback from their fans in order to deliver the sexiest and most satisfying massage simulator out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/1b2aecef5ad8dd878d279db79792664ef6a6026f.png[/img]

To keep you guys excited about what's to come we would like to introduce the next major character in our sizzling relaxation game, the gloomy Black Harpy!

The Black Harpy is a lazy girl who is always glued to her phone playing addictive mobile games. As she constantly slouches she developed a really bad posture and in order to relieve her neck and shoulder pain she decided to visit the Orc's massage parlor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/517cbdd3d0068d358e0b313323b9b5acb866d52d.png[/img]

You'll soon be able to massage her in the game and see the relief and pleasure wash over her tired face and maybe even witness a slight smile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/0114d842571885faf445a408682f909a9aa08ba5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/853ad460a19a959eeaac4de9d1a02284341e8e26.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ahsNpi.gif[/img]

Of course, that's not everything that we have in store! TorchEntertainment has already designed and planned out scenarios for other monster girls we will be revealing to you in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/9a9945c4ddb69fafbfeed5c907eb024694e0dc63.png[/img]

Here is a quick sneak peek of Tiger Girl, an overworked police officer who is looking for a criminal suspect who happens to look suspiciously similar to our Orc masseur!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/de25335589aea60583f3c5154386dcd104935681.jpg[/img]

While the Tiger Girl will most likely not in our Early Access release, her model has already been created and will be getting many aesthetic improvements going forward.

When it comes to the Mermaid Girl, however, for now, we would like to keep her backstory a secret, at least until the next major update comes around.

Lastly, Orc Massage will be getting an international release with multiple language support later on in development. Be sure to stay tuned for more announcements!
